facts.business: W.S. Industries (India) Limited is engaged in infrastructure development and construction contracts, including the development of integrated townships comprising logistics and industrial infrastructure.

capacity_or_capex.item: Interest-free advance to wholly owned subsidiary WSI-P&C Verticals Private Limited for acquiring land and developing integrated township
capacity_or_capex.timeline: As on 31.03.2026 (during the year Rs 25.50 Crores)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management expects that around 90% - 95% of the transaction price allocated to unsatisfied contracts as of 31st March 2025 will be recognised as revenue during next reporting period
guidance_or_targets.metric: Revenue recognition from unsatisfied performance obligations

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: (a) Note No. 34 - Amount payable to overseas customers/suppliers aggregating to Rs 5.55 crores written back during earlier years pertains to erstwhile Electro-porcelain products division (since discontinued) and management is in the process of obtaining necessary approvals from competent authorities. Impact not ascertainable. (b) Note No. 49 - Company engaged in implementation of construction contracts with cost budgets as management estimates; current process for arriving at project outcomes may be susceptible to deviations, impact ascertainable only upon completion of projects, hence no adjustments made.

key_risks: Subjective nature of construction cost estimation and revenue recognition for fixed-price contracts (Key Audit Matter)
Related party transactions with wholly owned subsidiary
Write back of amounts payable to overseas customers/suppliers pending regulatory approvals
Deviations in project cost budgets and outcomes ascertainable only upon project completion
facts.related_party_note: During the year, the Company advanced an amount aggregating Rs 45.50 Crores (during the year Rs 25.50 Crores) to its wholly owned subsidiary M/s. WSI-P&C Verticals Private Limited for acquiring land adjoining existing project site and to facilitate development of integrated township comprising logistics and industrial infrastructure. The advance was approved by the Board and Members under Sections 186 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013. No other loans, guarantees or investments were made under Section 186 during the year.
